checks.message: The only submitted boundary is explicitly marked provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false, and provisional_rough; the package states its permitted use and recalculation duty.
All three required key areas are present, non-overlapping, inside the site, and explicitly disclosed as provisional rough geometries.
The fifteen conceptual land-use polygons are generated by splitting one site polygon and therefore share boundaries, cover the site, and do not overlap.
Twelve scenario nodes record risk tier, required human review, minimum-data policy, a non-AI alternative, and concept-only trial status; four are isolated test/validation scenarios.
Site, green, public-space, building, route, land-use, and phasing metrics are recomputed from serialized GeoJSON in EPSG:4548; statutory controls remain unknown.
Formal facts return to registered official or cleared sources; provisional geometry and external cases carry explicit purpose and limitation fields.
The exhibit uses only inline CSS and local proposal figures; it contains no active code, external font, remote image, tile service, embedded page, submission control, API call, or tracking.
Original narrative, diagrams, HTML, and proposal geometry are released under CC-BY-4.0; no third-party visual asset or proprietary base-map screenshot is included.

The proposal explains all six agent tasks, thirteen required chapters, standards, design-depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, assumptions, three detailed areas, cases, personas, scenarios, landmarks, operation, and risk boundaries.
